Consider the statement, “If you will give me a cow, then I will give you magic beans.” Decide whether each statement below is the converse, the contrapositive, or neither. (a) If you will give me a cow, then I will not give you magic beans. (b) If I will not give you magic beans, then you will not give me a cow. (c) If I will give you magic beans, then you will give me a cow. (d) If you will not give me a cow, then I will not give you magic beans. (e) You will give me a cow and I will not give you magic beans.
